what: Ferguson is North America's largest distributor of plumbing and heating products. It supplies pipes, valves, fittings, heating and air conditioning equipment, and bathroom and kitchen fixtures to contractors and builders from a network of branches and distribution centres.
customers: Plumbing and heating contractors, commercial builders, industrial customers, water utilities and homeowners through showrooms.
money: plumbing, HVAC and fixtures for homes
commercial, industrial, civil and fire protection
moat: Branch density and inventory depth that let a contractor pick up almost any part the same day, which online sellers cannot match for job-site urgency.
risks: Residential construction and remodelling are weak while mortgage rates are high
Net margin of about 6% is thin, as is usual in distribution
Debt of about $8 billion against under $500 million of cash
Commodity price deflation in pipe and fittings reduces revenue
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 17% is high for a distributor
Data centre and infrastructure construction raises non-residential demand
Its own-brand products carry higher margins than the goods it resells
watch: Organic revenue growth split between residential and non-residential.
